name: isProgrammaticAccessEnabled
definition: An API key authenticated and read system information (the model's own call is the evidence).
population: the one firewall the credential reaches
evidenceRequiredForTrue: A successful authenticated system-information read with the credential.
citations: PAN-OS 11.1 XML API and configure CLI command hierarchy (docs.paloaltonetworks.com/pan-os/11-1/pan-os-panorama-api)

changeLog.change: Registered with its first implementation (synthetic-fixture tests only; no real device body replayed yet, so V0).

notes: result/system/sw-version or serial from the show system info reply. This is True only because the call authenticated; it cannot be False, because a refused key is Not evaluated.
